manifest.title: AI Gateway
manifest.tagline: One guarded entry point for coding agents' model and tool traffic
manifest.description:
AI Gateway puts one entry point in front of the model providers and MCP tool servers your coding
agents use. It is [agentgateway](https://agentgateway.dev), an Apache-2.0 Linux Foundation project,
packaged for Cloudron by Frivold Digital.

* **One place for policy.** Guardrails, rate limits, tool access and request logs are set on the
  gateway instead of on each laptop.
* **Works with Claude subscriptions.** Claude Code keeps each person's own Claude login; the
  gateway passes it on and holds no Anthropic key.
* **Two addresses.** The admin interface is behind Cloudron login. The agent endpoint is on a
  second domain and asks for a gateway key.
manifest.changelog:
* First version: agentgateway 1.7.0.
* Claude Code traffic is passed to Anthropic with each person's own Claude login; the gateway holds no provider key.
* A gateway key, generated on first start, is required on the agent endpoint.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
## Admin interface

Open $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN and sign in with your Cloudron account.

## Gateway key

A key was generated on first start. Read it in the app's **Terminal**:

    cat /app/data/.gateway_key

## Point Claude Code at the gateway

The agent endpoint is the second domain chosen at install (suggested: `gw-api`); it is listed
under the app's **Location**. On the machine where Claude Code runs:

    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://<agent endpoint domain>"
    export ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS="x-gateway-key: <the key>"
    claude -p "Hello"

Claude Code keeps using your own Claude login. Each request then shows in the admin interface
and in the app's log.

## Tools

A demonstration MCP server answers at `https://<agent endpoint domain>/mcp`. MCP clients send the
same key as `Authorization: Bearer <the key>`. Replace it with real servers in the admin
interface or in `/app/data/config.yaml`.

DATA_PLANE_DOMAIN.title: Agent endpoint
DATA_PLANE_DOMAIN.description: Where agents send model and tool traffic. Not behind Cloudron login; protected by the gateway key.
